name: Argentina
summary: Argentina has no investor visa that was found in an official source. Retirees and rentistas qualify for renewable temporary residence on income of five monthly minimum wages; remote workers get a 180-day residence. A citizenship-by-investment programme (USD 350,000 contribution or USD 800,000 bond) was announced in October 2026 but is not yet open. EU, US and other passports use the same routes.
naturalisation: Two years of legal, continuous residence under Law 346 as modified by DNU 366/2025 (processed by the migration authority, online since 6 October 2025); courts have declared parts of the decree unconstitutional.
dual_citizenship_note: Argentina does not require renunciation of another nationality (general position; not source-checked in this session).

routes.name: Temporary residence as pensionado (retiree)
routes.summary: One-year renewable residence for people with a regular, permanent foreign pension of at least five monthly minimum wages.
routes.requirements: Certificate of a regular and permanent pension of at least five Salarios Minimo Vital y Movil (SMVM); criminal records (Argentine and countries lived in over a year in the last three); proof of address; apply inside Argentina via RADEX. Law 25.871 art. 23(c), Decree 616/2010, DNM Disposition 1.732/2023 as amended by 3446/2023. Valid 1 year, extendable. Current peso value of the SMVM not read (secondary guides: ARS 376,600 in August 2026).
routes.physical_presence: Not stated in the sources reviewed (DNU 366/2025 reportedly cancels temporary residence after 6 months abroad)

sources.title: Obtener una residencia temporaria como pensionado

routes.tax_note: Foreign nationals become tax resident from the 13th month of presence (PwC); Argentina taxes worldwide income of residents.

routes.name: Temporary residence as rentista
routes.summary: Renewable residence for people with stable passive income (rent, dividends, interest) of at least five monthly minimum wages. Earned income does not count.
routes.requirements: Income equal to at least five SMVM from assets, not personal work; each applicant proves it; foreign bank accounts can count if the lawful origin is shown (Disposition 1.732/2023, per El Cronista 2023). Peso value not read. Guides suggest showing about USD 2,000 a month for safe approval.
routes.physical_presence: Not stated in the sources reviewed

routes.name: Citizenship by investment (Decree 524/2025, announced October 2026)
routes.summary: A planned route to Argentine citizenship for a USD 350,000 non-refundable contribution or an USD 800,000 zero-rate public bond. Announced in October 2026; applications expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.
routes.requirements: DNU 366/2025 changed Law 346 so a foreigner making a 'relevant investment' can obtain citizenship regardless of residence time; Decree 524/2025 created the Agency of Citizenship-by-Investment Programmes; the Ministry of Economy defines 'relevant'. Terms reported by Infobae (7 October 2026): USD 350,000 non-refundable or USD 800,000 zero-coupon bond; USD 100,000 extra for a spouse and unmarried children 18 to 25; USD 25,000 per minor. Rules for relevant investments, bond terms, tax treatment and residence requirements are not published; applications are expected from Q4 2026. A bill to repeal the DNU is before the Chamber of Deputies, and federal courts have declared parts of DNU 366/2025 unconstitutional (naturalisation articles). Law 27.802 (cited by PwC for tax residence) was not read.

routes.investment_options: USD 800,000 zero-rate public bond instead of the contribution; extra USD 100,000 per spouse or child 18 to 25 and USD 25,000 per minor.
routes.status_note: Announced in Paris on about 2 October 2026; implementing rules and an application channel not yet confirmed (Infobae, 7 October 2026).
routes.tax_note: Per PwC (existing file), naturalisation for relevant investments does not by itself make the person tax resident (Law 27.802).

routes.name: Digital nomad temporary residence
routes.summary: A 180-day temporary residence for remote workers, extendable once for 180 days. No official income minimum is published.
routes.requirements: Proof of active remote work for foreign employers or clients (contracts, invoices); health insurance and a clean record; nationals who are visa-exempt for Argentine tourism only; created by DNM Disposition 758/2022 per most sources (some cite other instruments). Government fees reported at about USD 200; income expectations of USD 1,500 to 2,500 a month in commercial guides.

sources.title: Digital nomad vs rentista visa Argentina 2026

routes.tax_note: Non-residents are taxed on Argentine-source income only.

open_questions: Citizenship by investment: check the Boletin Oficial for the Ministry of Economy resolution defining a relevant investment and for the application channel before opening the status.
Peso value of five SMVM not read from an official page; minimum_income left null (secondary guides: SMVM ARS 376,600 in August 2026).
Investor (inversionista) temporary residence and Mercosur residence were not found in an official source; not recorded.
Naturalisation: the 2-year rule is from secondary sources; courts have declared parts of DNU 366/2025 unconstitutional, so the rule in force is uncertain.
Government fees not read (migration fee table at argentina.gob.ar/cuadro-tasas-migratorias).
